approach: Fix the order where the fault is: in `check_and_verify` (run/mod.rs) delete the up-front `disk_gate`. `free_producer_build` already runs at the start of the Checks stage. Move the gate into `SnapExec::exec` (run/checks.rs) so it runs once, just before the first check that really executes. `SnapExec` only runs on the local path. A green or red CI result, a resumed job, a nested run and a fully skipped route never call `exec`, so none of them reach the gate. When the gate is still low, `exec` returns the `LowDisk` error. It passes up through `run_local` and `run_routed_with_record` unchanged: `Fallback` keeps the original error, and the `BadSha` and non-reuse branches use `?`. `check_and_verify` downcasts it, removes the verifier snapshot dir, and returns `hold_for_disk(ctx, closing, low)`, exactly the hold used today. Tests that mark "checks done" by the `verify` dir would now hold at the new gate, so their free-space helpers change to key on the Verifier-stage resume mark. Add drain tests for the false-hold fix, CI reuse under low disk, and the local-run hold. Add a CHANGELOG entry and one sentence in docs/architecture.md.

decisions.choice: Call disk_gate inside SnapExec::exec, guarded by a Cell<bool> so it runs once, after refuse_if_stopped and before the check seam or run_check.
decisions.reason: `exec` is called only when a check will execute locally, which is exactly 'only before a local check run'. It needs no change to the routing logic or the CI-result resolution, which are out of scope.

rejected.option: Keep one call in check_and_verify, moved after free_producer_build and before with_ci_source.
rejected.why: It would still gate before a green CI result is read, so a CI-supplied result could trigger a hold. That misses the request.

rejected.option: Add a gate hook parameter to routing::run_routed_with_record.
rejected.why: It changes a routing signature and its many callers and tests, and the brief says not to change routing rules. Only the Exec implementor needs to know.

decisions.choice: Surface the hold as an anyhow error carrying LowDisk out of the closure. check_and_verify then checks `downcast_ref::<LowDisk>()` on the with_ci_source result, removes verify_dir, and returns the existing hold_for_disk.
decisions.reason: hold_for_disk needs the owned Closing, which the closure can't hold. The existing hold path (records committed, no outcome, resume mark kept, next drain resumes) stays the only one.

rejected.option: Return the hold from inside exec by passing Closing into SnapExec.
rejected.why: Closing is moved and mutated by the caller afterwards, so the borrow does not fit.

decisions.choice: Change the 'checks have run' signal in the free-space helpers (drain.rs low_once_verifying, test_support::low_once_verifying, binary.rs copy) from 'a verify dir exists' to 'the resume mark says the verifier stage', i.e. `kept/<job>/resume.json` containing `"verifier"`.
decisions.reason: The verify dir is now made before the new gate, so the old signal would hold at the local-run gate and break the existing tests for the verifier gate (criterion 5). The Verifier-stage mark is written only after every check passed (`write_resume_mark` with `recorded_checks`), which is just before the verifier gate.

rejected.option: Make the verify snapshot after the gate.
rejected.why: The snapshot is needed before the CI read and before `exec`, since SnapExec borrows it. The verifier-stage logic would also change, which is out of scope.

decisions.choice: For the green-CI test in drain.rs, widen `ci_seam` in run/mod.rs from cfg(test) to cfg(any(test, feature="test-support")). A test falls back to NoCi only under cfg(test) and otherwise to the real gh. Add a small public installer and a fake gh Runner in test_support.rs.
decisions.reason: The integration test crate compiles athena-core without cfg(test), and the seam is thread-local on the test's own thread (drain tests call `athena.go` directly). The fake is a fake `gh` transport only; resolve, routing and the gate stay in production code.

rejected.option: Put the CI case in run/tests.rs only.
rejected.why: Criterion 2 names drain.rs and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.
It mutates process environment across parallel tests and relies on the host.

risks.risk: Existing tests that use 'a verify dir exists' as the 'checks have run' signal now hold at the new local-run gate (the verify snapshot is made before it), which breaks the verifier-gate tests.
risks.mitigation: Change the helper signal to the Verifier-stage resume mark in all four places (drain.rs, test_support.rs, binary.rs, plus scope_guard's use via test_support). Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` and `cargo test -p athena-core`.

risks.risk: A hold after the verifier snapshot, the CI-branch push and the early PR leaves state behind.
risks.mitigation: Remove `verify_dir` on the hold path (the same `remove_tree` already used for the timeout stop) and assert in the new tests that it is gone. A resumed job redoes the verifier snapshot as a normal Checks-stage resume does.

risks.risk: The gate runs on a nested or every-check call or twice.
risks.mitigation: The gate call sits in `exec` after `refuse_if_stopped`, behind a once flag. Pre-existing tests with plenty of space are unaffected, and the full `cargo test --locked` and clippy run in the final checks.

risks.risk: Space drops during the checks after the gate passes; before this change the gate did not cover that either.
risks.mitigation: Keep the gate to the first exec only, as the brief says ('just before a local check run'). The user's default says the workload is a false hold on the job's own build, which the order fix addresses.

risks.risk: Widening ci_seam to a feature changes the production code path (cfg(not(test)) real runner).
risks.mitigation: Keep the seam code behind the `test-support` feature, which only the athena-cli dev-dependency enables. Outside cfg(test), an unset seam falls back to the real GhCli. `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` must pass.

demonstrations.method: Add `writer_build_is_removed_before_the_checks_disk_gate_so_the_job_is_not_held` to drain.rs. The fixture is `disk_fixture()` (min_free_gb 10). The free-space reader is a new fn passed to `with_free_space`: it returns 3 GB while any `jobs/*/target/produce` exists and 500 GB otherwise. The wrapped script in the style of `go_with_disk` writes a `target/produce/big` file under the job dir when the Producer role runs. The test calls `athena.go(job, AcceptedBy::User, &lines)` and asserts the result is Finished (not a LowDisk Err) and that `jobs/<id>/target/produce` is gone. It also asserts the lines contain `disk       removed the producer's build directory` before the `checks     ` line, and that no `held       ` line appears.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes: the job reaches a verdict, the writer build is removed first, and there is no hold.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the old order (disk_gate before free_producer_build), the test's free-space function reports 3 GB while `jobs/<id>/target/produce` exists. The up-front gate holds the job with LowDisk, `go` returns Err, and no `checks     ` line is printed, so the test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `Athena::go` (via `Fixture::athena` and `go_with_disk`-style wiring). The fake is `StateDir::with_free_space(fn)` plus the scripted Producer closure that plants the build dir, both existing in drain.rs today. The free-space fn only reads the filesystem and holds none of the gate logic.

demonstrations.method: Add two tests to drain.rs, both using `disk_fixture()`. (a) `low_disk_with_a_green_ci_run_does_not_hold_the_checks_stage`: the repo gets a GitHub origin (`git remote add origin https://github.com/owner/repo`). The fixture's `url.<local bare>.insteadOf` setting lets the CI-branch push land locally. A guard from `athena_core::test_support` installs a fake gh Runner that answers the CI-run query with a green run for the candidate sha. Free space is a constant 3 GB through `with_free_space`. The test runs `athena.go`, asserts the result is Finished with no LowDisk Err, asserts a line starting `ci         checks reused from`, and asserts no `held       ` line. (b) `low_disk_with_no_usable_ci_result_holds_before_the_local_run`: origin and fake runner as in (a), but the runner answers 'no run', or there is no origin. The test asserts `go` returns Err downcastable to `LowDisk` (3 GB / 10 GB), no `checks     ` line, `read_hold` is Some, the job is Dispatched with no outcome, and the verify dir is gone. Then it frees space and `retry` plus `go` reach the checks.
demonstrations.observes: (a) passes: the green-CI job is not held and prints the reused line. (b) passes: the local path still holds, with the hold marker and amounts, and the checks do not run.
demonstrations.fails_without: CI case: with the gate still before the CI read, the job is held for low disk and 'ci         checks reused' never prints, so the assertion fails. Companion case: if the gate were dropped from the local path instead, the checks would run at 3 GB and the hold assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `Athena::go` with `with_ci_source`, `routing::run_routed_with_record`, `SnapExec::exec` and `hold_for_disk` all real. The fake is the gh `Runner` installed through the new `test_support` installer, which sets the thread-local `ci_seam` (widened by a plan step; today the seam is cfg(test) only and not reachable from drain.rs). Free space comes from the existing `with_free_space`.

Whether `Fallback` (routing.rs) keeps the LowDisk error type through `bail!` in the reuse route.
